## Modules

- [Membrane.RawAudioParser](https://membrane-raw-audio-parser-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RawAudioParser.md): This element is responsible for parsing audio in RawAudio format.
The Parser ensures that output buffers have whole samples.
